answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The zephyr edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 72 clones produces a signature the ferrous analysis flags immediately. An adversary must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the wander settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
